name: Nakano
tagline: Shinjuku in 6 minutes and Shibuya in 16 minutes. Served by 3 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Nakano City, where JR East and Tokyo Metro run 3 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 23 minutes to Otemachi, 6 minutes to Shinjuku, 16 minutes to Shibuya and 35 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 39.6 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 10.1 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 39.6 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 30.4 m to 40.5 m, a difference of 10.1 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 2 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 19 clinics and 37 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 健友会中野共立病院, about 6 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 新渡戸記念中野総合病院, about 7 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 3 lines serve the station. JR Chuo Rapid Line run through it. JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) also call here. Tokyo Metro Tozai Line are available too. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 2 lines and Tokyo Metro runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Tozai Line runs at 160% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 木場→門前仲町, which this station is not on. JR Chuo Rapid Line runs at 158% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 中野→新宿, which includes this station. JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) runs at 151%. Its busiest stretch is 錦糸町→両国, which this station is likewise not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000 and 2LDK ¥230,000 to ¥240,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is among the lowest in the 23 wards. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Nakano is ahead on rail connections and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Nakano. Shin-Nakano has only the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line, so Nakano is the better connected. To Tokyo, for instance, Shin-Nakano takes 5 minutes longer. A one-room flat also costs about ¥7,000 more at Shin-Nakano.

neighbours.lead: For safety, Higashi-Koenji; for rail connections, Nakano.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Nakano in a straight line. Higashi-Koenji has only the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line, so Nakano is the better connected. To Tokyo, for instance, Higashi-Koenji takes 7 minutes longer. On what it offers families, though, Higashi-Koenji comes out ahead.

notFor: The data does not show a drawback particular to this station
noiseSources: 中野通り (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 12 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: 3 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are heavily loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
